about: Real tr46 7.0.0's answers under Node v24.12.0, for every combination of its options: all 128 for toASCII and all 64 for toUnicode, which has no verifyDNSLength. Combination k has option optionOrder[j] on when bit j of k is set. The inputs are every IdnaTestV2.txt source, every WPT toascii.json and IdnaTestV2.json input (the ones tr46's harness skips included), the curated inputs of Scripts/generate-vectors.mjs and seeded fuzz inputs from Scripts/lib/fuzz.mjs, deduplicated, less the ones holding a lone surrogate, which a Swift String can't hold. An input is left out (excludedNewerThanNode) when it, either of its mapped forms or any answer holds a code point assigned in Unicode 18.0.0 that this Node's Unicode 16.0 leaves unassigned, because there Node's NFC may legitimately differ. Each vector is {input, toASCII: [[answer or null, mask], ...], toUnicode: [[domain, error, mask, replacedLoneSurrogates?], ...], age?}. A mask is hex, bit k for combination k, and the masks of one vector partition the combinations. A toUnicode domain is given as toWellFormed() gives it, with replacedLoneSurrogates true where that replaced a lone surrogate by U+FFFD. age is the highest DerivedAge among the assigned code points of the input, its mapped forms and the answers, present only above 14.0; the .foundation comparison skips those vectors.
